import.privacy: Your save is read in your browser. Only this is sent to the server: the list of collected items; the save's name, date and game build; for resource nodes the resource or purity your save sets and which extractor stands on which node (building, clock speed, Power Shards); and for the factory plan what is built where (buildings with their productivity, belts, pipes, power lines, roads, stations, vehicles, map markers, sign texts and the explored area). No player names or player positions.

saveWatcher.title: Automatic upload
saveWatcher.intro: A small script on your PC or server watches the save folder and uploads every new save to this world. ficsmap reads it like an import: checks, resource nodes and the factory timeline.

docker.compose: Unpack and start with Docker Compose
